youtube.aciklama: Usher syndrome combines sensorineural hearing loss with retinitis pigmentosa and is the most common cause of inherited deaf-blindness. The hearing loss is found early, but night blindness and a narrowing visual field begin years later, so the syndrome can be recognized late. Complaints such as falls in the dark call for an eye exam, and the person is referred through a physician.
